artifact_policy.Plans/_shards/**: derived regen-only shard output under /_shards/; regenerate after canonical doc edits, keep out of the packet doc intent set, and do not hand-edit
artifact_policy.Plans/.evidence/**: evidence-only regen-only output under /.evidence/; re-generate after verification /gates or canonical doc edits, keep out of the packet doc intent set, and do not treat as canonical plan prose
artifact_policy.Plans/Spec_Lock.json: governance regen-only /Spec_Lock.json maintenance target; keep out of the packet doc intent set and do not edit during transfer without explicit governance unlock
artifact_policy.Plans/auto_decisions.jsonl: governance regen-only /auto_decisions.jsonl maintenance target; keep out of the packet doc intent set and do not edit during transfer without explicit governance unlock
artifact_policy.Plans/.pipeline/verifier_exit_code.txt: derived verifier exit-code artifact; regenerate/revalidate after gates and do not treat as canonical plan prose
artifact_policy./.pipeline/verifier_exit_code.txt: path-normalized alias for the derived verifier exit-code artifact; process output only, never canonical plan prose

recovery_register_policy.MUST CHANGE: docs requiring direct canonical edits to land owner canon, retire stale same-file canon, or fix active fidelity blockers
recovery_register_policy.MUST RECONCILE: docs that are not primary owners for the feature but must stay coherent with the changed owner canon
recovery_register_policy.MUST VERIFY: docs checked for drift after owner/consumer changes without being packet doc intents

recovery_register_terms./fallback/freshness/degradation: alias for the Plans/Tools.md grep/search index owner bundle
recovery_register_terms./recovery/remote: alias for the Plans/GitHub_Integration.md remote cache/search recovery owner bundle
recovery_register_terms.owner-owned: label for source docs that remain the canonical owner for a feature contract; derived shards and evidence outputs must not re-own those contracts

special_recovery_register.owner_scope: The sharding config owns only canonical source registration, derived-output namespace policy, and recovery-register routing metadata; it does not treat pipeline ledgers or generated shards as owner docs.

artifact_namespace_policy.Plans/_shards/**: derived shard output only; never an owner-doc input
artifact_namespace_policy./_shards/: path-normalized alias for derived shard output
artifact_namespace_policy.Plans/.evidence/**: evidence output only; never a canonical plan source
